sourceNote: Official names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network, taken from Exophase on 18 November 2026 and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (via Planet GTA 6). Guides are written for this entry, in its own words, and cite their sources.

trophies.guide: The Platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut — it is a checklist of everything else in this guide, from the five story chapters to 100% completion. Work through the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story, all five chapters and the final mission.
Clear every stranger strand, collectible set and activity in stages 2 to 5.
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road — the Platinum follows immediately.

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is an early story mission — play the story and it unlocks on its own. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss; it is one of the first mission trophies you will pick up. If you are following the roadmap, it lands in stage 1 without any extra work.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the story until the Gone Fishing mission appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.guide: Chapter 1 ends when its last mission is done, and this trophy marks the moment. Before you leave Chapter 1, find Lucia's balcony meditation spot — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and the spot is gone after this chapter. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, because the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Make a manual save when Chapter 1 starts.
Find Lucia's balcony meditation spot before the chapter ends.
Play through to the end of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Chapter 2 is where the map really opens up: Jason and Lucia are both playable from here, and most of the free-roam trophies become possible. Finish the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at its close. Use the newly open world to start the long grinds — stunts, WAiNK spots and vehicle discovery — while you play.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Make a manual save when Chapter 2 starts.
Complete the chapter's missions in order.
Start the free-roam grinds (stunts, WAiNK, vehicles) alongside the story.

trophies.guide: Chapter 3 closes with this trophy. The robbery trophies start unlocking around Chapters 3 and 4, so once the chapter is done you can work on bank vaults, the armored truck and the jewelry store. Keep a manual save at the chapter start — there is no mission replay if you want to redo anything later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Make a manual save when Chapter 3 starts.
Complete the chapter's missions in order.
After the chapter, start the robbery trophies (vaults, truck, jewelry store).

trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the last chapter before the finale. Finish its missions and the trophy pops. Before you push into the final mission, make a separate manual save: the finale is also the point of no return for the story, and a save here lets you mop up anything story-gated afterwards.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Make a manual save when Chapter 4 starts.
Complete the chapter's missions in order.
Make another manual save before the final mission.

trophies.guide: The Gold for finishing the story. Play through the final mission and it unlocks at the end. After the credits the open world stays open, so everything you have not finished — collectibles, activities, robberies — can still be done. This is the end of stage 1 of the roadmap, not the end of the hunt.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapter 4, then play the final mission to its end.
After the credits, return to the open world for the cleanup stages.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission — it unlocks by playing the story, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. No preparation needed; just follow the mission objectives as they come. It is one of the named-mission trophies, so it sits in stage 1 of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission. Complete it and the trophy pops. Heist missions are usually longer and more involved than a standard mission, so go in with full health, armor and ammo, and keep a manual save from before it starts in case a retry is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Stock up on health, armor and ammo before starting it.
Complete the heist; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. It unlocks in the natural course of the story and the trophy pops when the mission ends. There is nothing extra to do — follow the objectives and finish the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission, and this trophy is its completion mark. Play the story until it appears, then finish it. The mission's name hints at a show-business setting; expect a set-piece rather than a quiet errand, and go in prepared.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around the airport. Complete it and the trophy pops. It pairs naturally with Catch Me If You Can, which is also about an unscheduled departure at VCIA — if that trophy has not popped by the time you finish this mission, try the airport again in free roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end of it.
Afterwards, check Catch Me If You Can — both are VCIA-themed.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission, and this trophy marks finishing it. The name suggests a big, loud operation — go in with full supplies and a manual save from before it starts. Complete the mission and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Stock up and make a manual save before starting it.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: The Gold for 100% completion is the last big gate before the Platinum. The game's own completion checklist has 35 tasks — story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the rest. This guide's stages cover all of them: finish stages 1 to 5 and the checklist will be at or near 100%. Check the in-game stats page to see which of the 35 tasks are still open, then close them one by one.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish stages 1 to 5 of this roadmap.
Open the in-game stats page and list the 35 completion tasks still open.
Close the remaining tasks; the trophy pops at 100%.

trophies.guide: 250 stunts is a pure grind, but it counts every stunt you pull off — jumps, near misses, airtime and the rest — so it builds up naturally if you drive fast and recklessly from the start of the game. Don't leave it to the end: weave stunt driving into every trip, use fast cars and bikes, and look for jumps and ramps around Leonida. The in-game stats track your count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive aggressively from early on: jumps, airtime and near misses all count.
Use fast cars and bikes and take ramps and jumps whenever you see them.
Check your stunt count in the stats page and grind the remainder late.

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in Leonida, and this trophy just asks you to try each one once — races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, drone races and the rest. It is a sampler, not a grind: work through the activity list early so you know which ones you enjoy, then the deeper activity trophies (gold medals, 20 races, 50 challenges) have a head start.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each one once — a single race, a fishing challenge, one arcade game.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 Shooting Range challenges, and every one needs a gold medal. This is the skill trophy of the set: learn each range's scoring, use the right weapon for the drill, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold is met. Start early and do a few ranges between story missions — it is much less painful spread out than ground out in one sitting.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and learn the scoring for each drill.
Replay each challenge until you hit its gold medal threshold.
All 42 golds are needed; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at several spots around Leonida, and you need a win at every one of them. Learn each course's line — drone races reward smooth flying and cutting corners over raw speed — and retry a location until the win lands. There is no count in the official description, so visit every Top Fun spot on the map and win each.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find every Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Learn each course, then win the race at that location.
Repeat at each location; the trophy pops on the last win.

trophies.guide: 20 different races — different events, not the same one twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida: street, off-road and whatever else the game offers. Pick the best car you own for each race type, learn the route on a first run, then win it. Keep a note of which races you have won so none gets repeated by accident.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: List the races available around Leonida.
Win 20 different ones, using the right vehicle per race type.
Track wins in this guide's checklist so you don't repeat one.

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a fishing rival, and this trophy is about beating him at his own game. Fishing challenges are timing and patience: learn the bite cues, keep the line tension in the safe zone, and don't rush the reel. Challenge Cal when you are confident with the mechanics — a practice round or two first makes the real attempt much easier.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Learn fishing first: practice the bite timing and line tension.
Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Beat his catch to take the trophy.

trophies.guide: One full arcade game, start to finish — the easiest trophy on this list. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; walk up to a machine, start a game and play it to the end. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so do it early.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine anywhere in Leonida.
Start a game and play it through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand, and this trophy marks finishing his last mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and meet people around Leonida — talk to everyone with a marker, follow Andy's strand through, and the trophy pops on his final mission. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks as well.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy's strand marker while exploring Leonida.
Play each of his missions in order.
Complete his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton has his own stranger strand, and this trophy is its ending. Find his marker, work through his missions, and finish the last one. Stranger strands are easy to miss if you rush the story, so sweep the map for markers between chapters — it also feeds Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton's strand marker while exploring Leonida.
Play each of his missions in order.
Complete his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with this trophy. Like the other stranger characters, his missions appear as markers around Leonida — follow them through to the final one. Do the stranger strands as they appear rather than saving them all for after the story; they are more fun that way and keep the map feeling alive.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy's strand marker while exploring Leonida.
Play each of his missions in order.
Complete his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: 8 full stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and more. Each strand is a small chain of missions for a character you meet in the world. The trick is finding them: stranger markers appear as you explore, so sweep each region, talk to marked characters, and finish one strand before starting the next. The individual strand finals have their own trophies too.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Explore Leonida and note every stranger marker you find.
Finish one character's strand completely before moving on.
Complete 8 strands; the trophy pops on the eighth.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with this trophy. Find his marker, play his missions in order, and finish the last one. Stranger strands are the side content that makes Leonida feel lived-in — don't skip them, because Strangers & Freaks needs 8 completed strands and several of them are easy to walk past.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy's strand marker while exploring Leonida.
Play each of his missions in order.
Complete his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with this trophy. As with the other strangers, his missions show up as markers in the world — follow the chain to its end. If you are hunting Strangers & Freaks at the same time, Tyrone's strand is one of the 8 you need, so it pulls double duty.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone's strand marker while exploring Leonida.
Play each of his missions in order.
Complete his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy in the set that can be missed. Meditation spots are scattered across Leonida, and one of them — Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 — disappears after that chapter ends. Meditate at every spot you find as you go, and above all do the Chapter 1 balcony spot before finishing Chapter 1. There is no mission replay, so a missed spot means a new playthrough or an earlier save. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Meditate at Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony spot BEFORE finishing Chapter 1.
Meditate at every other spot you find while exploring.
Keep manual saves at each chapter start — there is no mission replay.

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted — a specific creature, not just any wildlife. Unique animals are rare spawns tied to particular places or times, so this one takes patience: learn where Bret's target lives, go prepared with the right weapon, and be ready to track it. It is Bret's strand trophy, so it also counts toward the stranger content.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Find Bret and take his strand.
Learn where the unique animal lives and when it appears.
Hunt it with the right weapon and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in sets, and you need 3 full sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, on shelves, tucked into corners — so this is a thorough sweep of the map, best done with a checklist. Each set you complete also feeds the 100% completion count, so don't leave cards for last: grab them whenever you pass a likely spot.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up every collectible card you see while exploring.
Track which sets are complete and which cards are missing.
Complete 3 full sets; the trophy pops on the third.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging activity, and you need 100 locations tagged. It is a long grind, so start on day one: WAiNK every new place you visit, and use the map to find spots you have not covered. 100 sounds like a lot, but it accumulates fast if you tag as you travel instead of saving it for the endgame.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: WAiNK every new location you visit, from the start of the game.
Use the map to find areas you have not tagged yet.
Reach 100 tagged locations for the trophy.

trophies.guide: 50 challenges of any kind — the game tracks dozens of small feats, from driving to combat to exploration, and they stack up as you play. Check the challenges list in the pause menu to see what is close to done, then knock out the easy ones first. This one rewards playing broadly rather than grinding one thing, and it overlaps heavily with the other activity trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges list and see which are nearly done.
Finish the easy ones first, then work through the rest.
Complete 50 challenges; the trophy pops on the fiftieth.

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose it and escape. Get the heat up together — rob something loud, or stir up trouble in a busy area — then break line of sight, get off the road and hide until the stars fade. Doing it with your partner is the point: make sure they are with you before the wanted level climbs.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along before you cause trouble.
Raise a 4-star wanted level together.
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears.

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row, with your partner, without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route: three shops close together, a fast getaway car parked nearby, and your partner in the car. Rob the first, move fast to the second, then the third — speed matters more than stealth here, because the wanted level must stay live across all three.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and park a fast car nearby.
Rob the first shop with your partner, then move immediately to the next.
Rob all three without the wanted level clearing between them.

trophies.guide: 100 different vehicles discovered — just get in and drive them. Leonida is full of cars, bikes, trucks and boats, so this one builds up by itself if you try something new whenever you see it instead of always taking the same car. Parked cars, traffic and mission vehicles all count. Check the vehicle list in the stats to see what you still need.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive a different vehicle whenever you get the chance.
Try parked cars, traffic and mission vehicles — all of them count.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and lets you pick targets — and you need 5 takedowns inside one use of it. Set it up: find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus with full meter, and chain the shots quickly. A crowded fight or an ambush is the best place to try; if the meter runs out at 4, reload a save and try again with better positioning.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus with a full meter.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus ends.

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the airport, and this trophy is about leaving it in a way the airport did not schedule — grab a plane and take off without going through the usual channels. The description is deliberately vague, but the airport is the place: get to the runway, take a plane, and get airborne. It pairs with Hi-Jacked, the VCIA Takedown mission trophy.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA, the airport, in free roam.
Get to a plane on the runway area.
Take off without clearance for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks, and this trophy is about getting hot in one — drive a Rhino and stir up enough heat to make the description literal. Stealing a military vehicle draws a heavy response, so go in with a plan: grab the Rhino, survive the wanted level it brings, and have an escape route. The trophy's joke is the clue: it is hot in a Rhino because everyone is shooting at you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank — military areas are the place to look.
Take it and survive the response it draws.
The trophy pops once you have had your hot ride.

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: get in, take the jewelry, get out, and never trip the alarm or get spotted. Plan the approach — quiet entry, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are detected, leave and try again; the trophy only counts a clean run.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Scout the jewelry store first: cameras, staff, exits.
Enter quietly and take the jewelry without being seen.
Leave clean — no alarm, no detection — for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, each robbed and escaped from. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan each one, bring the right crew and gear, and have a getaway route ready before you go in. The escape is part of the trophy — losing the wanted level after the robbery is what counts. Spread them out across the robbery stage of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank vault robbery and plan the crew and getaway.
Rob the vault, then lose the wanted level to escape.
Repeat for 5 vaults; the trophy pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one, stop it, crack it open and escape. The robbery itself is quick; the escape is the work, because the truck's guards and the police response come fast. Pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit and a fast car for the getaway.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it, crack it open and take the cash.
Escape and lose the wanted level for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Visit every region of the map — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and everything in between. The game tracks which areas you have been to, so check the map for blank spots and drive through them. This one pairs perfectly with the collectibles: explore with WAiNK and the card hunt in mind and you will finish three trophies on one road trip.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Check the map for regions you have never visited.
Drive or fly through every blank area.
The trophy pops once all of Leonida is explored.

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations, and you need to rob one from each of them. Learn which gangs operate where, find their operations, and hit one per gang. Gangs defend their turf, so go in prepared — and remember which gangs you have already hit so you don't rob the same gang twice.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Learn which gangs operate in Leonida and where.
Rob an illegal operation belonging to one gang.
Repeat for each gang; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the only hint, and that is all the game gives you. Ocean Beach is the place, a cocktail with a view is the act: find a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a drink, and enjoy the view. The 5G secret trophies are like this by design: small, odd moments hidden in the world. Cited: Output Lag notes these have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in free roam.
Find a beachfront bar with a view.
Order a cocktail and take in the view.

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint. A vehicle showroom, smashed out of in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass. Find a showroom, pick a fast car, and leave through the front window. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Leonida.
Get in a fast car inside or near it.
Smash your way out through the showroom front.

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint. The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is the place, and follow-through is the act: bowl a full game there, and follow through on the throw. It pairs with Ten Pin, the other bowling trophy. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling there.
Follow through on your throws for the trophy.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint, and it is deliberately vague. A partnership with mass appeal suggests doing something with your partner that draws a crowd: a public stunt, a show, or a moment the whole city notices. Try partner activities in busy places and watch for the pop. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Bring your partner to a busy, public spot in Leonida.
Do something showy together that draws a crowd.
Watch for the trophy to pop on the partnership moment.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint. Choices made, for better or worse: somewhere in the story or the world there is a choice with consequences, and this trophy marks making it. Play through the story's choice points and stranger missions, and this one should pop on one of them. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the story and stranger missions, watching for choice points.
Make a choice where the game offers one.
The trophy pops on the choice it tracks.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint. Second time's the charm: something in Leonida is worth trying twice. A failed first attempt at an activity, a race, a stunt or a challenge, then a second try that lands it. If a 5G trophy hasn't popped and the description fits a retry, try the same thing a second time. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Find an activity or challenge you failed the first time.
Try it a second time.
The trophy pops on the second attempt that lands.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint, and the joke is the clue: something strange, surprising or scripted happens in Leonida, and this trophy marks the moment you see it. Keep an eye out for odd events while exploring — the weird corners of the map, strange encounters, things that make you stop and ask what just happened. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and strange spots.
Watch for scripted or surprising events in the world.
The trophy pops when you witness the one it tracks.

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the hint. Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: a melee attack from a moving vehicle, knocking someone over like a bowling pin. It pairs with Let's Go Bowling, the other bowling trophy. Try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon in a busy area, and aim to knock the target over rather than just hit them. Cited: Output Lag notes these secret trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive by a target slowly and strike with the melee weapon.
Knock them over for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money, and your contacts launder them for a cut. Earn $250,000 through laundering — it is a slow earner, so start early: every robbery and score throws off Marked Bills, and routing them through your contacts instead of spending them dirty adds up. Check the money menu to see how much you have laundered so far.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and scores.
Launder them through your contacts instead of spending them dirty.
Reach $250,000 laundered for the trophy.

trophies.guide: $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, everything counts. You will spend most of it naturally on gear and vehicles, so don't grind this one: just buy what you need as you play, and check the spending total in the stats. Big purchases like cars and garages move the number fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes, cars and supplies as you play.
Big purchases (cars, garages) move the total fastest.
Reach $100,000 spent across all shops.

trophies.guide: Garages are properties you buy, and you need all of them. They are scattered around Leonida and they are not cheap, so save up and buy them as you can afford them — each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Check the property list to see which garages you still don't own.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find every garage property for sale in Leonida.
Save up and buy them one by one.
Own all garage properties for the trophy.

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app registers vehicles — 10 of them. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the app, and register each one. It pairs with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles): register the interesting ones as you discover them, and the two trophies progress together. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so it is just a matter of doing it 10 times.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find a vehicle and open the Scooter Bros app.
Register the vehicle to the app.
Repeat for 10 vehicles; the trophy pops on the tenth.
